contacts.name: Town of Oakville — Planning & Building
contacts.notes: GET A NAMED CONTACT. Town dictates: pond size (fire-fighting water volume for a bubble + gas is greater than the driving range alone — any increase is Craig's cost); parking lot specs (shared proportionally); washroom / sewage / septic spec; whether the existing clubhouse is accepted as relocatable (floor reinforced to 50 lbs/sq.ft at the Town's earlier request). Bubble permit + grade-beam approval + pre-approval for an additional 4-court bubble all run through here.

contacts.name: Region of Halton — Roads/Permits
contacts.notes: William Halton Pkwy is a Regional Road (Burnhamthorpe was municipal). Additional permits are required for any work along a Regional Road — factor into the permit timeline.

contacts.name: Brad Davies, C.TECH
contacts.role: Sr. Analyst, New Business Project Coordinator
contacts.notes: NATURAL GAS QUOTE (Jul 30, 2026): no gas main fronts the property. Scope = 260m gas main extension + 120m service to the dome. Cost likely IN EXCESS OF $120,000 + HST (assumes adequate capacity, no rock excavation). Property-line-meter + private piping offset saves only $10-15K (needs a pricier 14 kPa meter). Tennis-only cost (golf range doesn't need heat). Self-perform excavation TBC. To proceed: submit a commercial service request via Enbridge GetConnected (enbridgegas.com/connect-to-gas/builders-hvacs).

contacts.name: Tomas Sharaf
contacts.notes: ELECTRICAL: on-site he revised the 600V/200A estimate to ~$100K (closest 600V is 3 pole-spans east of the gate). 240V single-phase (400A) is available at the driveway pole = cheap install. RESOLVED via Jim's ~$5k step-up transformer route (Option B) — makes 600V locally, bubble equipment untouched. Final Hydro cost is only set after the LOI is accepted and a contract is signed with Oakville Hydro.

contacts.name: Tennis Canada — Rogers Year-Round Program
contacts.notes: Up to $200,000 seed funding per project. Currently air-dome focused — confirm eligibility for the chosen structure type. Treat as de-risked capital in the Lakeside financing pitch (part of the ~$700K down: $500K reserve + $200K grant).
